priority_basis: Implement and test before relying on the affected control

priority_basis: Implement and test before relying on the affected control

evidence_required.must_show: Record the use/disclosure, secured-status basis and exact exception considered. priority_basis: Resolve applicability, authority or obligation before dependent execution

Test a delayed escalation, discovery by an agent, a shorter contractual limit, incomplete initial information and oral/written law-enforcement delays. Reject clocks restarted at management confirmation and treating day 60 as the routine target.

priority_basis: Resolve applicability, authority or obligation before dependent execution

Select downstream data flows independently from vendor lists; inspect signed scope and reporting paths. Exercise an unsuccessful cure and review documented termination feasibility.

priority_basis: Resolve applicability, authority or obligation before dependent execution
